messages:
olivia: Heads up — deploybot suppressed the canary rollout in us-west-2. p95 jumped 300ms -> 800ms over ~2m then dipped. Thinking manual rollback to v2.5.1 or hold 10m and monitor? need ops + eng decision. @sam @maria @tony
sam: Can you paste the p95 trend + error rate? if 5xx also spiked we should rollback.
olivia: p95 trend: 300ms -> 810ms -> 420ms -> 790ms. 5xx rate: baseline 0.8% -> 2.3% at spike. logs show kvcache miss spikes. telemetry: https://telemetry/redwood/rollouts/3509992222
deploybot: deploybot: rollout suppressed for canary-2026-03-23-19:37 reason=latency-oscillation threshold=alert-0.8 current_5xx=2.3% autosuppress=true
maria: If kvcache misses are high, likely a kernel/compat regression with the new build. Recommend pin and rollback to v2.5.1, then iterate on kernel patch. Also notify support + dedicated customers.
tony: +1 to pin+rollback. partial traffic split is riskier right now; prefer full rollback for canary so we can stabilize quickly.
sam: I'll execute manual rollback. olivia, can you draft the brief notif for #support and release-notes?
olivia: Draft: "Rolling back canary to v2.5.1 due to latency oscillation. Investigating KV cache regression. Expected customer impact: minimal; dedicated customers might see brief 5xx spikes. Will post follow-up." OK?
sam: LGTM :thumbsup:
sam: Running: `rctl rollout revert --env=us-west-2 --service=inference-canary --to-version=v2.5.1 --reason='kvcache-regression-latency'`
deploybot: deploybot: command accepted. starting revert. estimated_duration=120s
opsbot: opsbot: rollback started by sam at 3509992250. monitoring p95 and 5xx.
sam: Revert finished — p95 back to ~310ms, 5xx down to 0.6%. Please verify.
deploybot: deploybot: revert complete. pinned_version=v2.5.1 for inference-canary. canary rollout unset. Notifying stakeholders.
olivia: Posted notif to #support and emailed product leads. Filing follow-up: TKT-4521 to root-cause kvcache kernel mismatch. Closing thread.
